planting_and_placement.design_intent: Three independently rooted basal clumps; six unequal flowering uprights; fifteen folded strap leaves; eighteen three-petal clusters

limitations: Proposed components only, no recovered host/room/deck geometry
Soil/root reservation and depth are spatial proposals, no biological/species/irrigation/load claim
No engine, actor, collision behavior, wind, LOD or target-PC acceptance
Foliage decorative non-colliding; no foliage AABB as collision
Standing/seated outlook and maintenance clearances require the recorded relative arrangement
